column1: # French (fr) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in standard French, using the
# feature names French-speaking users of vector illustration software know (Plan de travail, Nuancier,
# Contour, Fond, Tracé, Point d'ancrage, Plume, Sélection directe, Pathfinder, Motif, Paramètre
# prédéfini, Calque). No other application's French localisation was copied. Labels use sentence case
# (only the first word capitalised); commands use the infinitive (Ouvrir, Enregistrer, Afficher) and
# sentences address the user as "vous". French typography: a no-break space before : ; ? ! and inside
# « », the typographic apostrophe ’. Shortcut keys use their French key-cap names (Maj, Ctrl, Alt, Échap).
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and every `tl!` literal (`complete_menus`,
# `untranslated_report` lists gaps). Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name, language
# names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names.
# Photoshop-style raster effects (Effect menu, their dialogs).
# Status and error messages too (`@msg` rows at the end, `COMPLETE_MESSAGES` in the tests).
# A native speaker's review is welcome: keep the placeholders ({name}), the trailing "…" and the
# leading/trailing spaces of fragments exactly as they are.
